## What's new

- **Themes:** dark, OLED black or glass, your own accent colour, opacity and corner style (Settings → Appearance).
- **Live activities in the pill:** a running focus timer, a meeting that starts soon or a screen recording shows in the
  closed notch with a countdown, like the Dynamic Island.
- **Calculator in the notch:** Ctrl+Alt+Space opens it ready to type. Sums, percentages and currency conversion with
  the NBP average rates ("15 usd in pln"); Enter copies the result.
- **New desktop widgets:** sticky notes, a to-do list, disks and system, app shortcuts, and **Games**.
- **Games widget:** all your installed games in one place (Steam, Epic Games, GOG, Riot, Battle.net, Ubisoft Connect,
  EA app, Rockstar and Minecraft) with covers, one click to play. Favourites stay on top, hide what you don't want,
  sort by recent, name, play time or your own order (drag the tiles).
- **Play stats:** NotchPC records how long you play and your average and low FPS. After a game the notch shows a short
  summary; the Games widget shows this week's play time and your last session.
- **Files and clipboard with your phone:** the phone page has a new Files tab: send photos and files to the PC (they go
  to Downloads\NotchPC and onto the shelf), take files from the shelf, and send text to the PC clipboard or copy the
  PC's recent clipboard texts.
- **A tidier notch:** at most 9 tabs in the bar (the rest behind "More"), rearrange tabs by dragging their icons.
  The Apps and Games tabs became desktop widgets; screenshot, snip and record moved to Quick settings.

The quick-note tab from the test builds is gone: if you used it, its text is now a sticky note.
